Spear Volley Hazard 2
MechanicalTrap

A pressure plate in the floor triggers a volley of spears from the west wall.

Stealth DC 18 (trained)
DisableDC 16 Thievery (trained) to jam the pressure plate
AC16; Fort +9, Ref +5
HP30 (BT 15); Hardness8; Immunitiescritical hits, object immunities, precision damage
Spear Volley ⬲ Trigger A creature enters one of the marked squares. Effect Three spears shoot from the west wall; the trap makes a ranged Strike against each creature in the corridor.
